basic_info.description: Beautiful 1 bedroom located on the border of Dogpatch and Potrero, just steps away from 22nd Caltrain station. This open floorplan features large windows throughout, an island in kitchen with high end finishes and top-rated appliances and Washer/Dryer in unit. Building amenities including a serene outdoor common area filled with a ton of greenery, 3 Fire pits, BBQ area and plenty of seating areas. Amenities also include state of the art Fitness Center, Media room, Package room, Bike room, Lobby attendant & smart intercom entry.
